title: studio/ideal.json
description: The ideal picture of every Target/Ideal view (structure, change, journeys, paths, data, infrastructure, pipeline and the plan's order): the rules' baseline with its evidence, the ideal the person's assistant planned on top of it after a critique pass, every planned element citing facts, claims, cards or rules that exist (an uncited element is dropped by the evidence check and listed), and each view's provenance: how it was made, by which assistant and model, when, its confidence, where it departs from the rules and why, and the questions it leaves for the person.
